summary.childSettings: Recommends child-directed requests and maximum G content rating; the current app already implements the supported child age treatment equivalent.
summary.android: Recommends API 33+ and no AD_ID permission; unchanged signed Android bundle targets 36 with the permission absent. Its AAID explanation does not answer publisher first-party ID initialization timing.
summary.disclosures: Endorses current official platform data-disclosure pages, confirms collection of IP/interactions/diagnostics/identifiers and TLS. Does not give configuration-specific residual iOS identifiers or tracking answer.
summary.kidsReview: States no specific external certificate of human age review is published, points to Families controls and claims typical Apple acceptance. Does not supply a public policy explicitly documenting the required human review.
summary.navigation: Confirms no built-in parental click gate and recommends custom interception/UI layers. Provides no supported cancel/resume API or code.

followUp.uses: Gmail plugin under the owner's current implementation/follow-up authorization; no attachments, credentials or child data sent
